AssistantStateResponse.description:
The one assistant: its active technical session (None before the first message), that
session's context state, and where the session starts in the timeline (messages before
``active_from_timeline_seq`` are not in the model's current context).
AssistantStateResponse.title: AssistantStateResponse

DiagLearningModel.description: The last background learning run: counts, codes and durations only.
DiagLearningModel.title: DiagLearningModel

DiagnosticsResponse.description: Technical state for the diagnostics panel. Never contains message content.
DiagnosticsResponse.title: DiagnosticsResponse

EffectiveSettingsResponse.description: Non-secret, read-only view of the effective configuration (Phase 1).
EffectiveSettingsResponse.title: EffectiveSettingsResponse

MemoryInboxItemModel.description: A decision waiting for the user. ``proposal`` is the fact in question (no raw payload).
MemoryInboxItemModel.title: MemoryInboxItemModel

RelationshipModel.description: One stored relationship, plus how it reads from the entity it was requested for.
RelationshipModel.title: RelationshipModel

TimelinePageResponse.description: A page of the single assistant timeline (all technical sessions), oldest first.
TimelinePageResponse.title: TimelinePageResponse

TurnSubmitRequest.description:
One user message to LAZIS. It always goes to the active technical session (created
with the very first message); the client never chooses a session. ``client_id`` is the
idempotency key: a retry with the same key is refused with ``turn_duplicate``.
TurnSubmitRequest.title: TurnSubmitRequest

get.description: ``entity_id`` may be ``user``: the user's own relationships.
